mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, compounded by risperidone's dose-dependent QT prolongation effect.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and consider alternative diuretic if QT prolongation develops.
